svg.text: FIG-R8 · Measured vs designed — the honesty map, one row per sub-layer
Source: R6 Full-Stack Atlas v0-1 §7 (parsed verbatim) and §2.L3 narrative
keys come from a cloud host's OS CSPRNG, or from
no key in this programme has lived in hardware
radio is a free-space model; time is the host clock
revocation lists are a Python dict or file
automine as the condition of every M1 row
no consensus protocol has been measured
gas is exact; price is ESTIMATED (#20)
ecrecover and bn256 are the load-bearing precompiles
per-function gas and attack cells for 10 columns
the thesis's core artefact; 117 SCF rows
did:ethr is real; did:mobi is real; the rest are synthesised
IDTX exists as code without a result
freshness and verifier v3 (#44–#48); message size
mobility is mocked in the runs of record
Red outline = consensus / finality / availability / persistence sub-layers: nothing above an automining single process has been executed. R6 §2.L3: "The repository's executed agreement mechanism
is Hardhat automine ... provides ordering trivially and safety and liveness not at all"; Besu, QBFT, Gasper, RocksDB, node permissioning are DESIGN.
